# The credit itself fails. The engine still runs the undo of the credit, because it cannot tell how much of a failed write happened. The undo reads the
# credit back first, finds that nothing was written, and posts no uncredit.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

deskinit
deskfakes
subst home/.desk/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env DESK_DIR=$WORK/desk

exec beehavereal item add desk shift-1 --title 'Morning shift' --body-file body.txt
exec beehavereal run shift-1 desk --workflow desk/workflow.star
stdout 'item shift-1 finished'

! exists writes.log
! exists mail.out
! exists home/.desk/sent.tsv

exec beehavereal status
stdout 'desk-2-r1\tfailed'
-- body.txt --
The morning shift.
